race.comment: MONEY HONEY (13) is a lightly raced filly who has tackled a couple of better races in her past two since a dominant fresh maiden win. She backs up quickly from Warrnambool behind Romantic Miss which is good form for this and with early luck from the wide gate she'll go close. LADY MAESTRO (12) is coming off a dominant win at Tatura against her own sex. Takes on the boys now but can win again. PLEASE ME DO (15) ran a solid race first up at Tatura and looks a key hope with natural improvement, she draws for a soft run. DO IT NOW (2) is coming off a a solid win last start and will be running on again.
